parameters.name: BackupDbNames
parameters.description:
The name of the database to be restored. Separate multiple databases with commas (,).

>  If you do not specify any database name, all databases in the instance are restored by default.

parameters.name: BackupId
parameters.description:
The ID of the DRDS backup set.

>  If you do not specify this parameter, the system restores data by time (PreferredBackupTime).

parameters.name: BackupLevel
parameters.description:
The level of the backup. Valid values:

*   db: The database level.
*   instance: the instance level.

parameters.name: BackupMode
parameters.description:
The backup method. Valid values:

*   logic: the logical backup.
*   phy: fast backup

parameters.name: DrdsInstanceId
parameters.description: The ID of the DRDS instance.

parameters.name: PreferredBackupTime
parameters.description: The restoration time of the instance, in the format of`  yyyy-MM-dd HH:mm:ss `.

example.unifiedCli: aliyun drds start-restore --drds-instance-id rds00000000 --preferred-backup-time 2019-09-10_20:18:18 --backup-mode phy --backup-level db --backup-db-names test1,test2 --backup-id 23000 --api-version 2019-01-23 --region cn-hangzhou
example.legacyCli: aliyun drds StartRestore --region cn-hangzhou --DrdsInstanceId rds00000000 --PreferredBackupTime '2019-09-10_20:18:18' --BackupMode phy --BackupLevel db --BackupDbNames 'test1,test2' --BackupId 23000
